title: Customer Support Executive
description: We are looking for a dedicated Customer Support Executive who can handle customer queries, process orders, and ensure a delightful shopping experience.
responsibilities: Respond to customer queries via phone, email, and WhatsApp
Process and track orders from checkout to delivery
Resolve complaints and escalate issues when needed
requirements: At least 1 year of experience in customer support
Excellent communication skills in Bengali and English

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Looking for a creative Digital Marketing Specialist to manage social media, run paid campaigns, and grow our brand presence across Bangladesh.
responsibilities: Plan and run paid campaigns on Facebook and Google
Manage social media content and community engagement
Track campaign performance and optimize for ROI
requirements: Proven experience in digital marketing and paid ads
Strong copywriting and creative thinking skills
Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools

title: E-commerce Operations Manager
description: Manage end-to-end e-commerce operations including inventory, order fulfillment, courier coordination, and returns processing.
responsibilities: Oversee inventory levels and stock replenishment
Coordinate order fulfillment and courier partners
Manage returns, exchanges, and refund processing
requirements: Experience managing e-commerce or retail operations
Ability to work with data and reporting tools
